reason: B is the stronger proposal because Al-containing Cr coatings can plausibly develop protective alumina-rich scales, whereas a 50–100 nm Hf layer is unlikely to remain an effective barrier at 1200°C given Hf–Zr chemical affinity and rapid nanoscale-layer consumption, and Hf also raises neutron-absorption concerns. B still requires proof that a few wt% Al produces a continuous barrier—especially at the buried interface—and both proposals inadequately specify exposure times or supporting evidence.
